purpose: Independent accounting review oracles; not a runtime fixture schema, import file or new posting interface.

conventions.money: Exact four-place decimal strings; never binary floating point. USD is a sample base-currency label, not a country choice.
conventions.journal_sign: Each expected line has nonnegative debit and credit, one side zero.
conventions.case_isolation: Each case starts from its own opening trial balance. Opening balances are already posted except AC09. Do not chain cases or post openings twice.
conventions.opening_profit: Prior-period earnings are included in opening equity. P&L covers this case entries only.
conventions.control_totals: AR/AP are positive outstanding amounts; credit adjustments reduce original open items. No independent unapplied credit/refund is assumed.
conventions.stock: Existing-mechanics cases assume reviewed activated opening detail, one location, one base unit, no negative stock, and dated immutable movements.
conventions.manual_cases: Manual policy cases give GL arithmetic but do not assert operational subledger support. Null stock delta is not a passed inventory reconciliation.
conventions.tax: REVIEW5 is an invented 5 percent review rate. Eligibility, jurisdiction, recoverability and fiscal document requirements are not decided.
conventions.roles: Account aliases below are local oracle shorthand. Resolve semantic references through the approved installation contract; review.* and profile.* are not installed semantic keys or new runtime roles.

required_failure_and_replay_checks: Exact command replay returns same durable result with zero additional journals, allocations or stock movements.
Same request identity with changed payload rejects.
Unauthorized actor and wrong company/book reject before any effect.
Closed period rejects new posting/reversal; the permissioned exception for backdating within an open period is explicit.
Direct financial reversal cannot leave unreversed stock effects; adapter cost and financial effects are atomic.
Overpayment, excesscredit/return, overreceipt and duplicatebillallocation reject.
Stock issue beyond available quantity and date before latest movement reject.
Stale preview/count/value snapshots reject; the whole compound operation rolls back on a later failure.
Zero quantity cannot retain carrying value; the final exact cost residual is consumed without floats.
Disabled optional modules block new writes while authorized historical reads remain available.
Manual cases must not become claims of deposit, manufacturing, custody, batch or regional tax capability.

primary_references.scope: Public overview only; cost/write-down/recognition questions where IAS2 applies. No complete standard reproduced.
Public overview only; earned-service questions where IFRS15 applies. No framework applicability conclusion.

cases.title: Purchase order, two receipts and one supplier bill with sample input tax
review_notes: PO for 10 units at 10 has no journal. Receipts of 6 and 4 units retain their original cost. Bill net 100 plus sample tax 5 matches both receipts; no duplicate inventory debit.

cases.title: Stock invoice and linked cost of goods sold
review_notes: Opening stock of 10 units carrying 100 is already activated. Sell 3 at 25 plus sample 5 percent tax. Financial and stock posting must commit together.

cases.title: Partial customer receipt preserves remaining open invoice
review_notes: Opening unpaid invoice 100 is already in AR. Receipt 40 is not new revenue. Remaining 60 must agree with aging and AR control.

cases.title: Partial supplier payment preserves remaining payable
review_notes: Opening bill 100 is already in AP. Payment 40 is not a second expense.

cases.title: Customer credit with original-cost stock return and original tax snapshot
review_notes: Opening position follows a completed earlier invoice; its profit is in opening equity. One of 3 sold units is returned intact at original cost 10. Credit net 25 plus original tax 1.25 reduces the unpaid invoice; no cash refund. A later configured tax rate must not change this credit.

cases.title: Billed supplier return and linked supplier credit
review_notes: Two units returned at original cost 10; supplier accepts net 20 plus original sample tax 1. The existing GRNI account clears the supplier credit against the physical return, leaving zero. Both effects commit together. No payment or refund is implied.

cases.title: Unbilled supplier return reduces GRNI without creating AP
review_notes: Return 2 of 10 received units before billing. No AP credit is created because no bill exists. Remaining billable receipt basis is 80.

cases.title: Dated reversal and corrected repost under one document identity
review_notes: Cancellation date is 2026-01-06. Keep original 30, reversing 30, corrected 25 and document identity utility-001. Do not rename it utility-001-1. Backdating requires separate permission and an open period. A closed reversal date must reject atomically.

cases.title: Opening TB once followed by unpaid and stock detail conversion
review_notes: Source TB includes AR 300, AP 100 and stock 200. Confirm it once. Detail conversion links to these exact controls; no new revenue, purchases, tax or stock GL. Unpaid values are outstanding at cutover after any prior payments.

cases.title: Weighted average and original-cost return after a later higher-cost receipt
review_notes: First two receipts give quantity 5, value 60, average 12. Issue 3 at cost 36 leaves quantity 2, value 24. Later receipt of 1 at cost 24 leaves quantity 3, value 48, average 16. Customer return restores original cost 12; final quantity 4, value 60, average 15. No negative stock or historical movement rewrite.

cases.title: Reviewed inventory value write-down preserves counted quantity
review_notes: Reviewed net realisable value 75 is a scenario assumption, not calculated by the system. Expected current quantity 10 and value 100 must still match under the book lock. Adjust value by -25 with a reason; no fictitious unit issue or backdated rewrite.

cases.title: Sample manual output tax: exclusive
review_notes: Sample 5 percent only; no national rate, tax eligibility or statutory invoice conclusion. Exclusive 100 and inclusive 105 must produce net 100, tax 5 and total 105. Later configuration changes do not rewrite the posted line snapshot.

cases.title: Sample manual output tax: inclusive
review_notes: Sample 5 percent only; no national rate, tax eligibility or statutory invoice conclusion. Exclusive 100 and inclusive 105 must produce net 100, tax 5 and total 105. Later configuration changes do not rewrite the posted line snapshot.

cases.title: Explicit purchase-price variance preserves receipt cost
review_notes: Receipt of 10 units costs 100; supplier bill net is 110. An explicitly approved expense variance of 10 clears GRNI. Receipt carrying value 100 remains immutable. Expensing this variance is a technical fixture policy for review, not a universal capitalization policy. Eligible costs requiring capitalization need an approved stock value adjustment and policy.

cases.title: Prepaid dues or deposit recognition worksheet
review_notes: Assume a twelve-month obligation earned evenly at 10 per month for this worksheet only. Receipt 120 is initially a liability; AR remains zero. Refund rights and tax timing need review. Generic manual GL can express the arithmetic; no deposit application, revenue scheduler or membership workflow is claimed.

cases.title: Customer-owned bicycle custody has no company asset posting
review_notes: One customer-owned bicycle is left for repair. No transfer of ownership is assumed. The custody event has no journal, company stock, fixed asset, income or invented monetary value. A later parts and labour sale is a separate shared AR transaction.

cases.title: Manufacturing conversion worksheet with separate abnormal waste
review_notes: Conditional policy exercise: the reviewer accepts materials 40, labour 20 and normal overhead 10 into finished cost 70. Abnormal waste 5 is a separate expense. Raw stock 15 plus finished stock 70 equals remaining value 85; WIP is zero. No runtime production, BOM, overhead allocation or inventory conversion adapter is asserted.

cases.title: Reviewed stock count shortage
review_notes: Fresh count 9 is compared with ledger quantity 10 and carrying value 100. One unit is short at cost 10. Reviewer supplies a reason and expense offset; no revenue or payable. Later count or value changes invalidate the preview.

cases.title: Nonstock expense bill and source-linked supplier credit
review_notes: Accepted reduction of 20 in contractor charge 220. Credit is linked to the original unpaid bill and reverses expense. It is not a supplier cash refund or a physical stock return.
